text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I'm just... average. I lacked the resolve, so I never pushed myself. Which means—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I'm not overdoing it! Since I've paced myself until now, I can keep pushing for the long haul!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Starting an early spurt, bit by bit.
If I can just keep running like that forever...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, we definitely will—!
Teaaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Hishi Miracle! Hishi Miracle!
It's Hishi Miracleeee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With a magnificent long spurt, a miraculous
victory—!! What an incredible race it has been!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaa!!! I did it, I did it,
I did itttt~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A thoroughly satisfying victory. And just as significant as the win was catching a glimpse of her hidden potential.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She's a stubborn, slow-to-start Umamusume. That's why you can't see her true worth without patiently running her over long distances.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her true grit as a stayer
was brilliantly displayed across
the long-distance 3,000m race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Traaaaiiiineeeer!!
choice_data_list: Well done, that was truly a miracle!
Good job, that was truly a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, coming~.
I'm, I'mmmm...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I participateddd!!
choice_data_list: That's your takeaway?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Of course it had to be this way~. After all, if I didn't enter, I wouldn't have been able to win~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I didn't run away...
Thanks to you blocking all my escape routes, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Compared to her reputation before her debut, this was a truly miraculous feat. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle's thoughts after pulling it off
were completely and utterly nooormal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san, it's the after-party~.
Okonomi, okonomi♪ La-la-laaa~!
choice_data_list: Yeah, great job at the Kikuka Sho.
Yeah, great job at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue for the afterparty was, naturally, an okonomiyaki restaurant.
The two of them decided to hold a meeting to look back on everything so far.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A review, huh~
How was it for you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on everything so far.
The very first thing that comes to mind is—
choice_data_list: “Those words” were right, after all.
“Those words” were right, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um... a phrase?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was right after her Debut,
a 2000m race...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The longer distance might've actually saved me.
If it were a sprint,
it probably would've been over in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but my engine's pretty slow to start up,
so a longer distance would be nice~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True to her word, Hishi Miracle delivered results in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... that's kinda embarrassing...
I was just going with the flow, not like I gave it that much deep thought~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Heh... But maybe I'll just pretend it did happen~.
Look at me, I'm amazing! Just kidding~!
choice_data_list: And you put in the "effort," too.
And you put in the "effort," too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as for that... I did it properly.
I can hold my head up just a little bit with pride.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I've never tried this hard
at anything before, so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, you managed to do it! You pulled it off!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You've grown so important now... I'm so glad you worked hard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle deeply savored the fruits
of her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This very confidence was the greatest thing
that would lead into the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as the two of them took a post-meal walk—
choice_data_list: Hishi Miracle, about your next race...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...
choice_data_list: There's something more important than just choosing your races.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: W-What could this be...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next target was practically clear.
Considering the staying prowess she displayed here in the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Next year's Tenno Sho (Spring) at 3200m is the strongest candidate. There's no other race that suits Hishi Miracle better.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, there's something far more important this time
than just deciding which race to run.
choice_data_list: You can declare it yourself now, right?
You can declare it yourself now, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: By myself...
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's how Hishi Miracle herself feels.
Yeah, based on Hishi Miracle's own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting a goal for yourself and pushing forward to do it.
Whether you can do that or not makes a huge difference.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: M-Mmh... Judging by today's race, it'll probably be that race next year, won't it...
choice_data_list: I need you to handle it swiftly and decisively!
Just handle it nice and quick, okay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Grrrr...
choice_data_list: Yo, the genius of decision-making!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No way, it's so obvious~
Still……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: The goal is... ten... ten...
choice_data_list: Ten—?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What I'm...!
Aiming for isssss!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Spring)~~~~!!!!!!
I'm gonna wiiiiiiin there!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Did you just say "win"?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, did someone say that?
Who?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Meeeeee?!
Ahhh, no, no! I just got carried away!
choice_data_list: Alright, it's a promise then.
Alright, promise?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeehhk, no waaaay.
I went too far. I went way too faaaaar!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Win... can I keep going until I win~?
But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll... give it a try. Maybe I can do it...
I already said it out loud, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A bashful smile.
Followed by the declaration of her first goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having made his presence known in a Kikuka Sho
without the top two favorites—
Hishi Miracle sets his sights on winning the Tenno Sho (Spring)."
